marker: # ref_size is the product length measured in the H37Rv assembly GCA_000195955.2 (AL123456.3) by in
# silico PCR with these primers, outer primer edge to outer primer edge. Every locus gives exactly
# one product there. The publication's table gives no amplicon sizes, so there is nothing to
# compare it with.
# IMPORTANT: MIRU-VNTR alleles are canonically assigned from amplicon size with the published allele
# calling table, which is not part of the table this scheme was built from. The copy numbers below
# are derived from the reference assembly, not published, so one may be offset from the canonical
# allele. Confirm them against that table, or supply it as bins.tsv, before a profile from this
# scheme is compared with published MIRU codes.
# unit_length is the published repeat unit length for every locus. Copy numbers were established
# three ways, all against the H37Rv amplicon:

#   repeat detection, which also reproduced the published unit length: 154 x2; 424 x2; 577 x3; 580 x3; 960 x3; 1644 x2; 2059 x2; 2163b x5; 2165 x3; 2347 x3; 2461 x3; 2531 x6; 2996 x3; 3007 x3; 3171 x2; 3192 x3; 4052 x5; 4156 x2
#   two adjacent copies of the published unit length that differ by a few bases, which the detector
#     skipped; counted with an allowance of 3 mismatches: 2401 x2; 3690 x2; 4348 x2
#   no pair of adjacent windows of the published unit length anywhere in the amplicon reaches
#     85 per cent identity, so the array is a single unit: 802 x1; 1955 x1; 2687 x1
# Neither the single copy loci nor the imperfect ones carry a pattern: one unit forms no array to
# cross-check, and counting an imperfect array needs a mismatch allowance that inflates the count
# at other loci. Their copy numbers rest on the measurements above. The tandem cross-check is
# therefore active on the loci resolved by the detector and skipped on the rest.
